growth_signal.value: Says over $500 million worth of events have been booked through the platform

raised.value: $70M Series B (after a €20M Series A in January 2025)

entry.idea: Companies waste huge amounts of time booking venues, hotels, and suppliers for offsites and events by hand, so Naboo built one platform that sources, books, and pays for all of it.
entry.lesson: Find a big, boring company expense that is still handled through emails and spreadsheets, and turn it into one platform that also enforces the company's own rules.
entry.name: Naboo

growth.basis: substitute: funding round bigger than the last (€20M Series A in Jan 2025 to $70M Series B in Feb 2026)
growth.reason: It closed a much larger funding round only about a year after its previous one, and signed big-name customers.

market.reason: Almost every mid-size or large company books offsites and events, in many countries.

tech.reason: It combines sourcing, booking, payment, and compliance into one AI-assisted platform, which is solid software but a well-funded rival could build something similar in a year or two.

entry.twist: It calls itself an 'event operating system' that also enforces company travel and event rules automatically, so nobody needs to check every booking by hand.
entry.who_pays: Company procurement, HR, and events teams pay to use the platform when they book venues and suppliers for their events.
entry.why_now: More companies now run offsites and in-person events again, but the tools to organize them are still scattered across emails and spreadsheets, so demand for one unified booking system is rising.
